evidence.excerpt: The Fig. 2 caption attributes the density peak in soft-transition models to "the discontinuity in the derivative of the projected profile" (Sec. 3.3). For any finite α the projected profile is C^∞ in R; only the α → ∞ limit (Eq. 2, Fig. 1) has a derivative discontinuity at Rb. The non-monotonicity in Fig. 2 therefore arises from a sharp but smooth transition, not from a discontinuity. Importing the Fig. 1 explanation into Fig. 2 misstates the mechanism.
